_comment: City landing pages. Each city becomes /landscaping-<slug>. Edit the intro/highlights to tune tone per neighborhood.

cities.name: Chicago
cities.headline: Chicago Landscaping & Hardscape Experts
cities.intro: From Lakeview brownstones to Lincoln Park three-flats, Chicago yards face tight lot lines, clay-heavy soil and brutal freeze-thaw cycles. We design and build paver patios, retaining walls, water features and full-yard transformations engineered for Chicago's climate and code.
cities.neighborhoods: Lincoln Park, Lakeview, Logan Square, Bucktown, Wicker Park, North Center, Roscoe Village, West Loop and Hyde Park
highlights: City permit experience for retaining walls over 4 ft and shared-lot drainage projects
Tight-access paver installation for narrow gangways and small Chicago lots
Heavy-clay soil grading and French-drain solutions for Chicago basements

cities.name: Evanston
cities.headline: Evanston Landscaping & Hardscape Design
cities.intro: Evanston's century-old homes, established trees and proximity to Lake Michigan demand a careful, design-first approach. We blend historic character with modern hardscape — paver driveways, custom cedar arbors, water features and full landscape renovations from CIVIC Center to South Boulevard.
cities.neighborhoods: downtown Evanston, North Evanston, South Boulevard, Northwestern campus area and the lakefront
highlights: Historic-home-friendly hardscape that respects existing architecture and mature trees
Lakefront erosion control and bluff restoration
Custom cedar arbors and trellises designed for Evanston's mature gardens

cities.name: Oak Park
cities.headline: Oak Park Landscaping & Hardscape Specialists
cities.intro: Oak Park's Frank Lloyd Wright-era homes deserve landscaping that complements the architecture, not competes with it. We specialize in Prairie-style paver patios, restrained hardscape, modular retaining walls and four-season planting plans across Oak Park and River Forest.
cities.neighborhoods: Frank Lloyd Wright Historic District, Ridgeland-Oak Park, the Avenue and the Hemingway District
highlights: Prairie-style paver layouts that complement historic architecture
Permit handling for Oak Park's stricter setback and grading rules

cities.name: Naperville
cities.headline: Naperville Landscaping & Outdoor Living
cities.intro: Naperville's larger lots and newer construction mean homeowners often want full outdoor-living transformations — paver patios, fire pits, pergolas, pondless waterfalls and pool-deck pavers built to handle DuPage County's freeze-thaw cycles.
cities.neighborhoods: downtown Naperville, White Eagle, Saybrook, Tall Grass, the Riverwalk corridor and the south Naperville school districts
highlights: Large-lot full-yard design and outdoor-living installation
Pool-deck paver systems engineered for slip-resistance and heat reflection
Pondless waterfall and koi-pond installations with year-round filtration

cities.name: Wilmette
cities.headline: Wilmette Landscaping & Hardscape Contractor
cities.intro: Wilmette's North Shore estates demand premium materials, precise drainage and four-season planting design. We install Unilock and natural-stone paver driveways, custom retaining walls, koi ponds and full landscape renovations across Wilmette, Kenilworth and Winnetka.
cities.neighborhoods: East Wilmette, West Wilmette, the lakefront, Kenilworth border and the New Trier school district
highlights: Premium natural-stone and Unilock paver driveways for North Shore homes
Engineered retaining walls for sloped lakefront properties
Koi pond and pondless waterfall installation with winterization service
